Sample 1 is described as one of the three Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si alloys designed by the ML model and fabricated by arc cladding for experimental validation.
The ML model predicted a microhardness of 521 HV for Sample 1 versus a measured 515 HV, giving the minimum error of 1.17% among the three samples.

Solid-solution formation criterion for the designed samples: solid solution phases form when δr < 0.066 and −11.6 < ΔHmix < 3.2 kJ/mol; the samples' δ values range 0.0335 to 0.0595 and ΔHmix ranges −1.213 to −0.451 kJ/mol, satisfying the criterion.

There is a labeling discrepancy for Sample 1's phase: the Results text calls the main phase the Fe-Cr phase with an FCC lattice and peaks 100/200/211, whereas Fig. 8 labels it Fe-Cr with reflections indexed (1 1 0)/(2 0 0)/(2 1 1) and describes a bcc-type solid-solution phase.
